entries.basis: Three independent listening reviews of Rosalía’s fourth studio album LUX, not just Berghain single or a live performance. Gio Santiago, Rhian Daly, Kelefa Sanneh original publisher articles opened; NME rendered after plain fetch 403. New Yorker web publication November 7 is distinct from November 17 print issue/URL. Excerpts retain praise and criticism; editorial sentiment is excerpt-specific, not publisher numeric rating.
